title: NCSC Top 10 and the Falcon boundary
subtitle: Native capability, ecosystem dependencies and residual obligations

framework.name: NCSC Critical Controls
framework.publisher: New Zealand National Cyber Security Centre

assessment_scale.native_direct: CrowdStrike authoritatively performs a material part of the requirement.
assessment_scale.native_direct_bounded: CrowdStrike directly performs part of the requirement only for documented platforms, workloads, sources or authentication flows.
assessment_scale.native_supporting: CrowdStrike supplies prevention, discovery, prioritisation, detection, response or evidence but does not own the required control.
assessment_scale.ecosystem: Another technology, platform control or organisational process is required.
assessment_scale.gap: No sufficient native capability was evidenced or the requirement remains organisational.

interpretation_rule: This is a product-capability crosswalk. It does not infer NCSC conformance from product licensing, deployment, configuration or detections.
overall_conclusion: CrowdStrike provides strong but bounded support for patching, MFA, centralised logging, asset discovery, application control, least privilege and host-firewall enforcement. Password-manager provision, awareness training, backup and recovery, full asset lifecycle, business-process verification and enterprise network segmentation remain ecosystem or organisational responsibilities.

controls.title: Patch software and systems

official_requirements: Inventory software, firmware, devices and dependencies.
Operate a repeatable notification, prioritisation, testing, deployment, rollback and verification process.
Keep systems current and make delay or cancellation an explicit risk decision.
Cover endpoints, servers, network devices, IoT, applications and legacy components.

native_modules.how: Discovers vulnerabilities, unsupported software and exploit context.
native_modules.boundary: Does not deploy every patch.

native_modules.how: Identifies managed, unmanaged and unsupported assets and software.
native_modules.boundary: Does not establish complete enterprise inventory.

native_modules.how: Deploys supported Windows patches and reports host status.
native_modules.boundary: Windows- and catalogue-scoped in the cited evidence.

native_modules.how: Correlates asset, exposure, deployment and change records.
native_modules.boundary: Requires source integrations and an organisation-defined process.

ecosystem_controls.how: Patch non-Windows and out-of-catalogue software.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Coverage, deployment results and version compliance.

ecosystem_controls.how: Patches routers, firewalls, IoT, drivers and firmware.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Inventory, advisory mapping and verified deployment.

ecosystem_controls.how: Governs standard/emergency changes and exceptions.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Timestamped notification through validation and exception records.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Native deployment does not cover the complete NCSC scope.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Assign a patch mechanism and owner to every asset class.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Discovery and status do not prove risk acceptance.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Record and re-evaluate delayed or cancelled patches.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Delivery does not prove effective installation.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Independently verify versions or remediated exposure.

controls.threat_driver: Exploitation remained the leading initial-access vector in pending ThinkThreats evidence, making current, measurable patch coverage a direct compromise-risk control.

controls.title: Implement multi-factor authentication and verification

official_requirements: Identify critical, sensitive, administrative and internet-accessible systems and users.
Require appropriately strong multiple factors.
Independently verify sensitive payment, reset and data-change requests.
Govern enrolment, recovery, exceptions and authentication evidence.

native_modules.how: Provides phishing-resistant FIDO2 authentication for supported flows.
native_modules.boundary: Platform prerequisites and connectors prevent universal coverage.

native_modules.how: Applies identity-risk and conditional-access policy to supported paths.
native_modules.boundary: Overlays rather than replaces the authoritative IdP.

native_modules.how: Centralises authentication and policy events.
native_modules.boundary: Completeness depends on source onboarding and identity correlation.

ecosystem_controls.how: Extends MFA across required services.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Service inventory, effective policy, enrolment and sign-in results.

ecosystem_controls.how: Covers customer and non-federated flows.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Flow tests and bypass inventory.

ecosystem_controls.how: Verifies sensitive requests through a trusted second channel.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Process, approval and call-back records.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Universal authentication coverage is architecture-dependent.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Maintain a service-to-authentication register and close bypasses.

gaps_and_residual.gap: MFA does not satisfy business-process verification.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Operate independent verification resistant to account compromise.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Recovery, break-glass and non-human identities remain external.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Design, test, monitor and review those paths.

controls.threat_driver: Stolen credentials, vishing and help-desk manipulation make both strong MFA and independent business-process verification necessary.

controls.title: Provide and use a password manager

official_requirements: Provide an approved password manager to all staff with organisational access.
Drive broad adoption of long, strong and unique passwords.
Store credentials and recovery material only in approved secure ways.
Govern hosting model, MFA, recovery and adoption.

native_modules.how: Reduces password exposure for supported passwordless flows.
native_modules.boundary: Is not an enterprise password vault.

native_modules.how: Detects credential misuse and suspicious identity activity.
native_modules.boundary: Does not generate, store, share or rotate user passwords.

native_modules.how: Can centralise password-manager, IdP and help-desk events.
native_modules.boundary: Requires a password-manager platform and connectors.

ecosystem_controls.how: Generates, encrypts, stores, shares and administers credentials.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Coverage, MFA, vault configuration and audit logs.

ecosystem_controls.how: Controls onboarding, offboarding and emergency recovery.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Lifecycle and recovery-test records.

ecosystem_controls.how: Migrates unsafe storage and measures use.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Adoption metrics, exceptions and remediation.

gaps_and_residual.gap: No native password-manager capability was evidenced.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Provide and govern a dedicated enterprise password manager.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Passwordless coverage does not remove all secrets.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Inventory and vault residual credentials.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Identity detections do not prove adoption.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Measure usage and remove unmanaged storage.

controls.threat_driver: Credential theft and attacker manipulation of password-reset processes make unique password storage and controlled recovery business priorities.

controls.title: Centralised logging

official_requirements: Identify critical events and systems that must be logged.
Collect logs centrally and protect them from unauthorised change.
Correlate events and create actionable alerts.
Manage source coverage, time, retention, access and incident use.

native_modules.how: Ingests, normalises, searches, correlates and alerts on native and third-party telemetry.
native_modules.boundary: Only covers correctly onboarded and retained sources within entitlement.

native_modules.how: Collects, filters, transforms and routes telemetry.
native_modules.boundary: Is a pipeline, not a SIEM.

native_modules.how: Provides continuous endpoint and cross-domain telemetry.
native_modules.boundary: Does not represent the complete log estate.

native_modules.how: Ingests supported cloud audit logs and detects cloud control-plane activity.
native_modules.boundary: Requires provider logging, enablement and a separate SKU.

ecosystem_controls.how: Produces and transports all required event classes.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Source register, connector health and ingestion tests.

ecosystem_controls.how: Makes records reliable, durable and protected.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: NTP, retention, archive and access-review evidence.

ecosystem_controls.how: Turns events into detection, triage and response.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Rule catalogue, runbooks, cases and SLAs.

gaps_and_residual.gap: SIEM ownership does not prove source completeness.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Maintain a required-event/source coverage matrix.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Native telemetry excludes many business and infrastructure systems.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Onboard and validate external sources.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Storage and detection do not guarantee action.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Staff, test and measure monitoring and response.

controls.threat_driver: Pending ThinkThreats guidance warns that telemetry gaps and outdated infrastructure documentation can block effective response.

controls.title: Build security awareness in your organisation

official_requirements: Establish leadership support and a positive reporting culture.
Deliver ongoing and role-relevant education.
Address phishing, downloads, credential requests and sensitive processes.
Measure behaviour and improve the programme from incidents and exercises.

native_modules.how: Aggregates identity, phishing, endpoint and incident data for behavioural themes.
native_modules.boundary: Does not deliver training or simulations.

native_modules.how: Provides incident patterns for exercises and targeted communication.
native_modules.boundary: Detection data is only an input.

native_modules.how: Supplies current adversary context for scenarios.
native_modules.boundary: Does not establish staff knowledge or behaviour.

ecosystem_controls.how: Delivers training, simulations and tracking.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Curriculum, results and completion metrics.

ecosystem_controls.how: Embeds expectations and role-specific content.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Leadership messages, onboarding and acknowledgements.

ecosystem_controls.how: Converts incidents and exercises into interventions.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Trend analysis and corrective actions.

gaps_and_residual.gap: No native awareness-training capability was evidenced.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Operate a dedicated training and simulation capability.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Telemetry does not prove behaviour change.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Measure reporting, repeat failure and process performance.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Generic annual training is not an ongoing programme.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Deliver continuous, role-relevant interventions.

controls.threat_driver: Vishing and help-desk manipulation show that attackers exploit people and business processes as well as technical weaknesses.

controls.title: Asset lifecycle management

official_requirements: Record software, hardware, cloud and supply-chain assets with owners.
Record and harden assets before use.
Link assets to patching, vulnerability, configuration and support status.
Plan end of support and securely decommission and dispose of assets.

native_modules.how: Discovers managed, unmanaged and unsupported assets.
native_modules.boundary: Does not govern procurement, ownership or disposal.

native_modules.how: Adds exposure, configuration and attack-path context.
native_modules.boundary: Security exposure is one lifecycle dimension.

native_modules.how: Queries state and inventories software on covered hosts.
native_modules.boundary: Covered endpoints are not the full estate.

native_modules.how: Adds external, shadow and OT/IoT discovery.
native_modules.boundary: Coverage remains product- and collection-dependent.

ecosystem_controls.how: Maintains authoritative identity, ownership, dependencies and lifecycle.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Reconciled register, owners and quality metrics.

ecosystem_controls.how: Registers and hardens new assets before use.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Security gates and owner assignment.

ecosystem_controls.how: Removes access and data and securely disposes of assets.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Approvals and sanitisation/destruction records.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Falcon is not the authoritative lifecycle system.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Reconcile discovery into CMDB/ITAM.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Procurement, development and supplier lifecycle are outside scope.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Embed registration and security gates in those processes.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Unsupported-asset detection does not retire assets.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Fund and track remediation or risk treatment.

controls.threat_driver: Unknown or outdated assets create exploitable exposure and leave responders without reliable infrastructure context.

controls.title: Implement and test backups

official_requirements: Identify systems, data, configurations and owners requiring protection.
Define RPO and RTO from business requirements.
Protect and retain separated backups securely.
Verify jobs and test complete restoration with dependencies.

native_modules.how: Detects or prevents ransomware and destructive behaviour.
native_modules.boundary: Does not create or restore backups.

native_modules.how: Investigates and contains activity affecting backup infrastructure.
native_modules.boundary: Containment is not recoverability.

native_modules.how: Detects risky access involving backup administration.
native_modules.boundary: Does not segregate recovery identity or storage.

native_modules.how: Correlates backup, identity and endpoint alerts.
native_modules.boundary: Backup assurance depends on source-platform evidence.

ecosystem_controls.how: Creates, retains, isolates and restores backups.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Coverage, job success, immutability, retention and restore results.

ecosystem_controls.how: Separates recovery identity and clean restoration.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Architecture, independent credentials and exercise results.

ecosystem_controls.how: Define RPO/RTO and accept restored services.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Approved objectives and sign-off.

gaps_and_residual.gap: No native backup creation or restoration capability is evidenced.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Deploy and govern dedicated recovery technology.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Detection cannot prove recoverability.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Test end-to-end restoration and dependencies.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Production compromise can reach backup administration.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Segregate recovery identity and retain immutable or offline copies.

controls.threat_driver: Attackers target backup, identity and virtualisation layers to deny recovery, requiring isolated and tested restoration capability.

controls.title: Implement application control

official_requirements: Decide what applications and file types are permitted or restricted.
Block malicious, unwanted or unapproved execution.
Where allowlisting is used, progress from audit to enforce mode.
Maintain group/device policies, detection updates and monitoring.

native_modules.how: Blocks malicious and prohibited behaviour with ML, IOAs, exploit mitigation, script controls and custom IOAs.
native_modules.boundary: Does not create a complete business-approved allowlist.

native_modules.how: Records execution and supports investigation and containment.
native_modules.boundary: Does not define approved software.

native_modules.how: Centralises execution and allow/block events.
native_modules.boundary: Requires complete authoritative policy sources.

ecosystem_controls.how: Provides integrated deny-by-default allowlisting.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Policy, coverage, block events and exceptions.

ecosystem_controls.how: Provides approved-execution policy.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Enforced rules, scope and audit-to-enforce testing.

ecosystem_controls.how: Defines approved software and exceptions.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Requests, approvals, expiry and review.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Native deny-by-default allowlisting was not evidenced.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Add an allowlisting engine where required by control design.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Behaviour blocking is not business approval.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Maintain an approved-software model.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Complete special-workload coverage is not proven.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Define and test scope and exceptions.

controls.threat_driver: Pre-approved tools reduce out-of-baseline installs and opportunistic infection from self-installed software.

controls.title: Enforce the principle of least privilege

official_requirements: Identify and justify minimum permissions for every account type.
Use roles and separate administrative from everyday accounts.
Limit privilege by task and time, including just-in-time access.
Review entitlements and monitor privileged activity.

native_modules.how: Records just-in-time, just-enough privilege and privileged-session control.
native_modules.boundary: Dedicated corroborating product notes are absent; scope and evidence exports require validation.

native_modules.how: Detects identity threats and conditionally enforces supported paths.
native_modules.boundary: Does not own every role or lifecycle process.

native_modules.how: Finds excessive/dormant cloud permissions and supports bounded remediation.
native_modules.boundary: Capabilities differ by cloud provider.

native_modules.how: Applies privilege governance in supported SaaS integrations.
native_modules.boundary: Does not cover the whole estate.

ecosystem_controls.how: Owns roles, lifecycle, approval and certification.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Entitlements, approvals, reviews and deprovisioning.

ecosystem_controls.how: Controls credentials and sessions outside native scope.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Coverage, JIT/check-out and session records.

ecosystem_controls.how: Separates and hardens privileged access.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Device/network policy and access tests.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Universal privilege coverage is not proven.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Map every privileged path to an enforcement owner.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Role design and approval are external governance.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Establish roles, separated accounts and justified workflows.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Risk findings do not prove revocation.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Certify access and remove dormant/excess privilege.

controls.threat_driver: Rapid attacker hand-off and Tier-0 compromise risk make time-bound, monitored privilege essential to containing credential compromise.

controls.title: Implement network segmentation and separation

official_requirements: Identify devices, users, data, dependencies, ports and protocols.
Divide networks into zones based on function, sensitivity and trust.
Control and minimise connections between zones.
Harden devices and monitor remote, wireless, physical and cross-zone access.

native_modules.how: Centrally manages host-firewall rules on supported Windows, macOS and Linux hosts.
native_modules.boundary: Does not create enterprise zones or control every network path.

native_modules.how: Adds network-related telemetry, detection and endpoint containment.
native_modules.boundary: Detection and containment are not segmentation architecture.

native_modules.how: Correlates endpoint, firewall, network and cloud events.
native_modules.boundary: Depends on complete integrations.

native_modules.how: Discovers supported OT/IoT assets and ingests partner visibility.
native_modules.boundary: Discovery does not enforce segmentation.

ecosystem_controls.how: Enforces zone boundaries and permitted flows.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Architecture, rulebase, reviews, tests and logs.

ecosystem_controls.how: Controls device/user admission and dynamic access.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Policy, posture, authentication and access decisions.

ecosystem_controls.how: Maintains zones, flows, ownership and exceptions.
ecosystem_controls.expected_evidence: Diagrams, inventory, changes and penetration tests.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Native enforcement is mainly managed-host firewall policy.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Use network and cloud platforms for authoritative segmentation.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Telemetry does not prove prohibited paths are blocked.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Test allowed and denied flows from each zone.

gaps_and_residual.gap: Unmanaged, appliance, wireless, remote and OT paths can bypass endpoint controls.
gaps_and_residual.residual: Include every path in design, monitoring and exception review.

controls.threat_driver: Lateral movement and attacks on edge, core and recovery infrastructure make blast-radius reduction a business resilience requirement.

limitations: This is a product-capability crosswalk, not an assessment of an organisation.
NCSC reviews the Top 10 annually. This briefing applies only to the 21 September 2026 snapshot, reverified on 22 September 2026.
The capability mapping used for this framework records metadata only: no detailed controls and no control mappings. The crosswalk is analyst-authored.
Product notes used here are working material rather than finished product assurance.
All selected ThinkThreats claims were pending review on 22 September 2026.
No customer deployment, configuration, exception or operating-effectiveness evidence was supplied.
Product availability, licensing, platform support and names can change and must be validated before implementation.
